description: We are a team of 3 passionate Computer Science students interested in AI/ML, web development, space technology, and real-world problem solving. We enjoy turning innovative ideas into practical solutions using Python, machine learning, and modern web technologies. We are participating to explore satellite data and build impactful solutions for Earth. We welcome teammates skilled in GIS, remote sensing, data science, satellite imagery, UI/UX, and geospatial analysis who are excited to innovate.
